details:
Description

This begun occurring a couple weeks back. In instances with a lot of people i'm noticing a ton of intermittent freezing in some cases lasting upwards of a minute or more at a time. During this my gpu appears to spike up to 100% and the game stream via Virtual Desktop becomes a slideshow. As far as I can tell, I only experience this issue in VRChat. My NVidia drivers are up to date.

Reproduction Steps

Unsure if its primarily my system affected but I've heard a few others seem to be experiencing something similar. Usually just being in highly populated instances with people visible seems to be enough to trigger it in some cases. Might be tied to having a lot of concurrent avatar download/inits.

Details

- Category: Performance

- Frequency: Often
